Congratulations on achieving your Enriched Air Diver certification, Ethan!
We're so happy that you've taken this step in your diving journey!
As a diver, you’re already part of an exclusive community. To make the best of your diving status join PADI Club™ and access free and discounted online scuba diving courses, as well as an annual subscription to Scuba Diving(R) magazine and member-only events and meet ups.
Here at PADI we’re dive-fanatics and would love to help guide you through your adventure by sharing incredible dive destinations, PADI courses, products, event invitations and more, straight to your inbox. By signing up you’ll also get 10% off* your next eLearning course! What are you waiting for?
Join The Community
Unlock Adventures with PADI Club™ Membership
PADI Club is the ultimate community of ocean lovers and adventure seekers. Membership benefits include 20% OFF select PADI eLearning(R) courses, a FREE DAN(R) Prepared Diver course, annual subscription to Scuba Diving(R) magazine, dive travel and event invites, 20% off PADI Gear™, 25% off an eCard or a physical certification card (perfect for remote destinations), and more!
5% of every Club membership is donated to PADI AWARE™ for global ocean conservation and marine animal protection.
